title: Robin Hood: Men in Tights
tagline: A feast for merry men. Tights optional.
about: Robin of Loxley comes home from the Crusades to find Prince John running England, and gathers a band of merry men in tights to fight him.
cue: Carry in the roast pork when the fight breaks out at Prince John's banquet.
faces: COME ONE, COME ALL, TO THE FEAST

Prince John's BanquetRobin Hood: Men in TightsA feast for merry men. Tights optional.Every recipe serves 4.
    First CourseSecond CourseThird CourseFourth Course
    First CourseLittle John's toll bridge bread rollsNo tolls, then we don't eat no rolls. Rosemary pull-apart rolls, honey butter.How to make it500g bread flour7g sachet dried yeast1 tsp sugar320ml warm water3 tbsp olive oil2 rosemary sprigs, leaves chopped1 tsp sea salt flakes, plus 1 tsp for the dough100g soft butter2 tbsp honeyMix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, water and oil into a dough and knead until smooth.Cover and leave until doubled.Shape into 12 balls and pack them into a lined tin, then leave to puff.Brush with oil, scatter with rosemary and salt flakes and bake at 210°C until golden.Beat the butter with the honey and serve with the warm rolls.Loxley and Bagelle bagels with loxLoxley and Bagel? It can't miss, says Tuckman. Toasted bagels, smoked salmon, cream cheese, capers.How to make it4 bagels, halved250g cream cheese2 tbsp chopped dill1 lemon250g sliced smoked salmon1/2 red onion, very thinly sliced2 tbsp baby capersBeat the cream cheese with the dill, lemon zest and pepper.Toast the bagel halves until golden.Spread thickly with the cream cheese and drape over the salmon.Top with onion and capers and a squeeze of lemon.A bowl of Life SaversLatrine's cure for a sword through the middle.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Second CourseNot-a-wild-boar roast pork with applesA wild boar? No, that's a wild pig. Crackling pork belly, roast apples, gravy.How to make it1.5kg boneless pork belly, skin scored1 tbsp sea salt flakes1 tsp fennel seeds4 red apples, halved2 brown onions, halved1 tbsp plain flour375ml chicken stock125ml cloudy apple juice800g potatoes, for mash60g butterPat the skin very dry and rub with the salt and fennel seeds.Roast on the onions at 230°C for 30 minutes, then at 160°C until tender, adding the apples for the last 40 minutes.Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter.Rest the pork, then stir the flour into the pan juices and whisk in the stock and apple juice for gravy.Carve into thick slabs and serve with apples, mash and gravy.King Richard's homecoming chicken and leek pieIt's good to be the king, says the Rabbi. Chicken, leek and thyme under golden pastry.How to make it800g chicken thigh fillets, diced2 leeks, sliced40g butter3 tbsp plain flour375ml chicken stock150ml thickened cream1 tbsp Dijon mustard4 thyme sprigs2 sheets of frozen puff pastry, thawed1 egg, beatenBrown the chicken in half the butter and set aside, then soften the leeks in the rest.Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream, mustard and thyme, return the chicken and simmer until thick.Cool the filling, then spoon it into a pie dish.Cover with pastry, crimp, cut a steam hole and brush with egg.Bake at 200°C until puffed and deep golden.Third CourseLatrine's eyeball souffle omeletteLatrine's omelette, eyeballs and all. Sweet souffle omelette, lychee eyeballs, jam.How to make it6 eggs, separated60g caster sugar1 tsp vanilla extract30g butter565g tin lychees, drained125g blueberries4 tbsp raspberry jam1 tbsp icing sugarPush a blueberry into the hole of each lychee to make eyeballs.Beat the yolks with half the sugar and the vanilla, and whisk the whites with the rest to stiff peaks, then fold together.Melt the butter in an ovenproof pan, pour in the mix and cook gently for 3 minutes, then finish under the grill until puffed.Warm the jam, spoon it over, slide the omelette out, dust with icing sugar and stare back with the lychee eyeballs.Fourth CourseRabbi Tuckman's spiced sacramental grape juiceSacramental, says Tuckman. For blessing only. Warm spiced red grape juice, orange, cinnamon.How to make it1.5 L red grape juice1 orange, sliced2 cinnamon sticks4 whole cloves1 star anisePut the grape juice, orange and spices in a pot.Warm gently without boiling for 10 minutes.Ladle into cups.
